dct_creator_sm: Bergevin, Michele (Department of Population Medicine. Ontario Veterinary College. University of Guelph.). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-7835-8924
dct_description_sm: Dataset includes two components within a single spreadsheet: (1) Cache Valley virus (CVV) antibody titres sampled from mature ewes in summer 2021 for the purpose of establishing flock CVV seroprevalence in Ontario, Canada; (2) Survey results capturing farm management practices for the purpose of analyzing risk factors associated with CVV seropositivity.
dct_title_s: Cache Valley virus seroprevalence and associated farm management practices in Ontario sheep
